protocol.selection: Fixed ordered pool. Accept by full source import, exact independent output, graph budget and real S0/S1 non-advance reachability only. No timing or model-score filter. Replacements stay in preassigned split; shortages reported.

proposal.selection: union of frozen full legal argmax proposals at each real prefix; same extra labels for all methods, no validation/test supplement

development.selection: Joint A/B final validation regret then q MAE across prelisted mixed recipes; no test access. Main always fixed final200, no earliest-tie deployment.

training.selection: fixed-final-200; common LR selected only by G2 train/validation diagnosis; same minibatch order for all four methods

large_application.license: SQLite public domain; original amalgamation header
large_application.scope: Full SQLite3 library TU import/structure feasibility only; shell not yet linked. Never claim whole executable MLIR success from library import.

protocol.test_policy: Only default legality/correctness during corpus construction. Freeze training recipes and weights before one formal raw/guarded activity. Seen families never relabeled blind.
protocol.limits: No new backbone/action/loss/threshold changes. Whole original programs, no synthesized copies. Actual terminal attempts including failures and defaults charged separately from distinct objects and measurement repetitions.

audit.note: programs, context rows, distinct objects and strong pairs are separate counts; all alias byte comparisons direct
